dataset: UCI Spoken Arabic Digit (MFCC utterance classification)

parsed.padding: right-pad each utterance with zeros to 93 frames; flatten 93x13 to 1,209 inputs
parsed.speaker_partition: source documentation states official test speakers differ from training speakers; text files have no per-utterance speaker IDs

pilot.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (6 GiB)
pilot.early_stop: stop after 20 epochs without validation accuracy improvement
pilot.validation: stratified utterance-level 20% of official training data (132/class; 1,320 utterances); 5,280 train utterances remain; source files do not expose verified speaker IDs for validation grouping
pilot.preprocessing: per-feature mean/std fitted only on the 5,280 training utterances

disposition: Cross out for the hard non-saturated benchmark suite: both plain full-batch MLPs reach 96.5% accuracy on the official unseen-speaker test split. It passes open-license, anonymous-download, fixed-width MLP and full-batch GPU checks, but the task is near-ceiling for the tested architecture range. The internal validation split is utterance-level because the source files provide no speaker IDs; only the official test is documented as speaker-disjoint. This is one seed and two representative architectures.
